# Millionærklubben Eksklusiv: Danmarks største aktietalent  - del 1

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-11-06  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This is a Danish Millionærklubben live event that looks back on an eight-week stock-picking game. The winners made about 30%, mostly from Genmab and Torm, while the hosts' own returns ranged from -10.7% to +9%. The panel also discusses a volatile Danish reporting day: Maersk fell despite strong results, and Ambu and Matas dropped sharply. Lars Svendsen keeps a long-term contrarian Danish view (Lundbeck, Harboe, H+H, Maersk, Torm, Matas) and argues small caps move more. Michael warns that the large swings could mean a late-cycle market.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 HLUN-B — Lundbeck | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Lau says it is undervalued; the 60-65 target is only an intermediate stop.

#### Reasoning

Host Lars Svendsen holds it privately and says Lundbeck is undervalued. He bought around 35, it is now 55, and he targets 60-65 as only a stop on the way. He notes momentum has turned and technical analysis shows a buy signal, while the market is starting to recognise the value.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the momentum/buy signal reverses
- if the market keeps ignoring it after a 4-5 year horizon

> *"jeg mener, at Lundbæk er en af de undervurderede aktier og den skal op i 60-65 stykker"*

---

### 🟢 MAERSK-B — A.P. Møller-Mærsk | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 70%

Strong results but the stock was punished. Lau bought and will add more if it trades just below 20 (as quoted).

#### Reasoning

Lau calls the selloff a 'perverse reaction' to an actually strong report. He bought and plans to add on further weakness. He also notes that the A/B spread has narrowed from a systematic ~800 kr, which may reflect short covering.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the selloff reflects real earnings deterioration
- if the stock does not rebound

> *"hvis AP ligger her, måske lige under 20, så skal jeg have nogle flere af dem"*

---

### 🟢 TRMD-A — Torm | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 70%

Lau bought on the day and recommends it repeatedly. It was the biggest winner for Persson (+34%) and was held by the game winner.

#### Reasoning

Lau thinks Torm will bounce faster than Maersk after the selloff and keeps recommending it. Persson made money buying the post-dividend dip. The hosts tie it to oil and tanker strength from the Middle East conflict.

#### Sell Triggers

- if oil/tanker rates fall
- if the Middle East conflict de-escalates

> *"Den ligger til højrebenet, du."*

---

### 🟢 HH — H+H International | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Takeover candidate. Lau bought at 95-100 and expects ~140 in a bid.

#### Reasoning

Lau holds it as a takeover candidate. A Polish deal is pending regulatory approval, and if that fails another bidder could take the company, giving 'two chances'. He expects around 140 in a bid but admits the timing is unknown.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the Polish deal and other bidders both fail to materialise
- regulatory rejection without an alternative bid

> *"så får vi vel de der 140 for den, og så er vi jo glade"*

---

### 🟡 HARB-B — Harboes Bryggeri | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Lau sees it as a takeover target; a sale to Heineken or similar could take it from 120 to 350.

#### Reasoning

Lars Svendsen is patient with a long-term 4-5 year horizon. He thinks the family brewery could be sold to a European brewer at a large premium. It is a small company (~500m kr market cap), and he argues small caps can move more.

#### Sell Triggers

- if no sale/strategic change happens over several years

> *"så koster den aktie jo ikke de der 120, så kommer det at koste den jo 350"*

---

### 🟢 MATAS — Matas | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Lau calls it a completely smashed stock in clean-up mode that you should buy.

#### Reasoning

After the sharp drop on restructuring, Lau sees a contrarian opportunity and draws a parallel to GN Store Nord blossoming after many setbacks.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the clean-up fails to restore earnings

> *"det er jo sådan en aktie, der ligger fuldstændig smadret, at man skal gå ud og købe"*

---

### 🟠 GRLA — Grønlandsbanken | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Speculative 'black or white' stock; Lau made 21% in the game.

#### Reasoning

Lau sees it as illiquid and wild, with upside from growth in East Greenland and political attention. He would like to own it but calls it speculative.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Greenland growth story fades

> *"hvis I vil have noget, der er sort eller hvidt, så køb Grønlands Bank"*

---

### 🟠 ZEAL — Zealand Pharma | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Fell from 300 to ~250; Lau bought too early and flags competition from Novo and Lilly.

#### Reasoning

Lau holds it at a loss. He warns that while approvals drag on, competitors such as Novo and Lilly advance in the obesity market, so Zealand risks arriving too late.

#### Sell Triggers

- if competitors capture the obesity market first
- regulatory delays

> *"konkurrencen er jo vel den, især i sådan nogle tilfælde, er vel den værste, vi har"*

---
